provenance.author: AUD-08 smallest slices (Claude)
provenance.notes: Fault-free twin: G-STOP-L-01 (same market, slot and signal). The bot loses the exchange from 1 min after the open of candle 281 (UTC ms 1708113660000) until the open of 284 (1708156800000): it cannot read or send anything, so it takes no decision. The protective stop-market at 98.02 rests ON THE EXCHANGE and fills there in candle 282 at 98.02 x 0.9998 = 98.000396, exactly as in the twin. After recovery the bot learns the fill from the exchange order record (AUD-03: only the final order record is truth) and books it with the exchange time: i_out 282, STOP_HIT, R -1.059307099 - never at the recovery candle 284, never as a bot close or resync, and no second close order. Deterministic: seed null.
